Xi Jinping, Putin may attend India-hosted BRICS Summit in September

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are likely to attend the BRICS Summit in India in September. The summit is scheduled to take place amid ongoing conflict in West Asia. China has expressed support for India hosting a successful summit but has remained evasive regarding Xi Jinping's specific attendance. The attendance of the leaders is considered significant in the current geopolitical climate.
